title: R、L、C 各自吸收的功率

求电阻吸收的有功功率 P_R、电感吸收的无功功率 Q_L、电容吸收的无功功率 Q_C，以及电源的视在功率 S。

en.title: Power absorbed by R, L and C
statement: A sinusoidal source U̇_s = 100∠0° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s, has R = 50 Ω, L = 25 mH and C = 20 µF connected in parallel across it.
Find the real power P_R absorbed by the resistor, the reactive power Q_L absorbed by the inductor, the reactive power Q_C absorbed by the capacitor, and the apparent power S of the source.

questions.ask: Real power absorbed by the resistor, P_R = ?
questions.explain: All parallel elements see U = 100 V: P_R = U²/R = 10000/50 = 200 W.

questions.ask: Reactive power absorbed by the inductor, Q_L = ?
questions.explain: X_L = ωL = 1000 × 0.025 = 25 Ω, Q_L = U²/X_L = 10000/25 = 400 var (positive: the inductor absorbs reactive power).

questions.ask: Reactive power absorbed by the capacitor, Q_C = ?
questions.explain: X_C = 1/(ωC) = 1/(1000 × 20×10⁻⁶) = 50 Ω, Q_C = −U²/X_C = −200 var (negative: the capacitor supplies reactive power).

questions.ask: Apparent power of the source, S = ?
questions.explain: P = 200 W, Q = 400 − 200 = 200 var, S = √(P² + Q²) = 200√2 ≈ 282.8 VA. Note that S is not the sum of the elements' apparent powers.

hints: Every parallel element has the full source voltage U = 100 V across it.
P_R = U²/R, Q_L = U²/X_L, Q_C = −U²/X_C; add the P's and the Q's separately, then S = √(P² + Q²).
solution: **2. Power of each element** (all at U = 100 V):
- the resistor absorbs only real power: P_R = U²/R = 10000/50 = **200 W**, Q_R = 0;
- the inductor absorbs only reactive power: Q_L = U²/X_L = 10000/25 = **400 var**, P_L = 0;
- the capacitor only supplies reactive power: Q_C = −U²/X_C = −10000/50 = **−200 var**, P_C = 0.
**3. Source.** Real and reactive power are each conserved: P = 200 W, Q = 400 − 200 = 200 var, S = √(200² + 200²) = **282.8 VA**, power factor cos φ = P/S = 0.707 (inductive).
Apparent power is not conserved: the elements' S values add up to 200 + 400 + 200 = 800 VA ≠ 282.8 VA.
